Frequently Asked Questions

What PP cup calibers are shown in the latest catalog?

The catalog shows 80, 82, 85, 90, 92, 95, 105, 108, 109 and 119mm formats. The exact shape and dimensions vary by model.

Are all PP cups suitable for hot drinks?

The supplied catalog does not provide one verified temperature rating for every PP row. Confirm hot-service suitability and food-contact documents for the exact model before production.

Which PP models are square cups?

The catalog includes 82mm square rows and 92mm square rows. Some image text requires factory confirmation, so request the final drawing for the selected model.

Can the same lid or film fit every 90mm PP cup?

No. Similar nominal calibers do not prove a shared fit. Confirm the exact rim profile, lid, film and sealing-machine tooling with a physical sample.
